item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant: The utilities plant page no longer calls it…
item.description: The utilities plant page no longer calls it a central plant serving the campus; a 2017 notice calls it the 'existing Preliminary Utility Plant' on Block 16B and does not say more. The page also corrects a 2021 reference to the 2017 notice. Source: CEQAnet SCH 2013092047 document 15 (ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2013092047/15); UC Regents Item 101C, May 17, 2000; OpenStreetMap way 135103720.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant: The record described its shape as a real…
item.description: The record described its shape as a real OpenStreetMap building footprint; OSM way 135103720 is actually a fenced industrial compound (tagged as industrial land use with a fence, not as a building), and the record now says so. It also said a CEQA filing gave the plant's address as 1500 Owens St, conflicting with OSM's 1480 4th St. The CEQA filing cited gives only Block 16B and no street address, and no record read gives 1500 Owens St, so the conflict was removed from the record's notes, address and open questions. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording. Source: OpenStreetMap, way 135103720 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/135103720); CEQAnet, UCSF Mission Bay Utility Distribution System Extension, SCH 2013092047 (https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2013092047/15); Wikimedia Commons, file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg); Wikimedia Commons, User:Firstcultural (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Firstcultural).
